Qwen3-8B Q8_0 on llama.cpp, temperature 0.7, 64 tokens. 30 questions × 4 samples per dose. Labels come from a strict LLM judge that agreed with hand labels on 84% of 150 replies. The curve shows the share of replies that match the neuron's persona, with a 95% bootstrap range over questions. The ring values were read by eye from the source figure, so treat them as approximate. Code and data. Keys: ← → change the dose, ↑ ↓ change the question.
